entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to reduce token usage and latency, achieving significant task-completion gains through background session extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session history while supporting local operation without the need for external API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official Hermes provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and enables multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and videos.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls. It is designed for multi-user company environments, providing synthesized answers with citations, gap analysis, and scoped data access.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a 'learn, retain, recall, and reflect' workflow for long-term agent memory. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering clients for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables stateful agents by using background reasoning to update peer representations from session history. It serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers and supports managed, local, or Docker-based deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that relies on a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and provides sub-millisecond performance via MCP and native SDKs.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system utilizes a seven-layer memory architecture including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts. It employs a 'Ground Truth' hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and includes an auto-curated wiki for persistent knowledge.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and traces. It uses outcome-gated promotion to ensure context changes are only applied based on verified trials.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for message persistence. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep to ensure no details are lost during complex agent tasks.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from over 20 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of past data. It uses MCP recall for searching months of history and redacts keys and tokens during indexing to ensure safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores data locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context while supporting multi-project scoping to separate global, team, and project knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer offers portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients, achieving 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It supports automated memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents through dedicated plugins.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP and specific agent hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema. It functions without vector databases or embedding models, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows via WSL2.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to facilitate prefix reuse. This approach reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result. It manages the memory lifecycle through contradiction tracking and hygiene passes, supporting both embedded in-process execution and HTTP backends.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI allows for the autonomous maintenance and evolution of persistent, source-grounded knowledge without a vector database. It preserves citations and temporal memory while supporting portable archives for merging data between stores.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that features automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory kernel stack for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files before the agent's context window opens, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text retrieval, and ranked graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed context layer provides a source-neutral migration workflow for chat and document exports across coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It ensures data integrity through hash-checked proposals and receipts for all reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via a 1-10 importance ranking system. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction for retrieval.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking every prefetch operation. It distinguishes itself by supporting real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables budget-bound agent wallets to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for API access autonomously.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate capability routing within Hermes Agent. It provides native tools for graph navigation and automatically generates tool routing notes using model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and retrieval. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize how the agent accesses stored information.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin adds private local code memory to repositories through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and provides LLM-callable tools for models that support structured tool use.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term agent recall.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports Hermes agents by implementing automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information density.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit manages agent memory through a git-backed directory of versioned markdown files, utilizing 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data. It provides five slash commands for memory capture and recall, generating evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology rooted in TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles to automate specification elicitation and implementation planning. It integrates with various coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured approach to agentic software engineering.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that enables the generation of web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts in formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4. It features a coding-agent CLI and utilizes the DeepSeek Harness for native agent runtime support.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured cybersecurity skills across 34 domains, mapped to major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. The collection is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is accessible via a CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project manages natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to facilitate secure escrow and dispute resolution during transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content through a two-pass editing process to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It offers Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes with customizable voice profiles ranging from professional to casual.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for platforms like Hermes and Claude Code. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring the collective evolution of agent capabilities.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains persistent session state directly within a project's documentation folder to ensure continuity.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This repository contains 1,174 professional skills distributed as human-readable markdown files under the MIT license. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with ready-to-paste exports available for other major assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This project enables agents to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse channels or playlists on YouTube. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and provides reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host system.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes edits made in source files back to the original literate documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite or Full modes. It incorporates a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project quality before handoff.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer architecture consisting of a kernel, plugins, and recipes to implement the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian community by providing installation guides and agent skills formatted in Portuguese. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with broader ecosystem integrations.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable agent discovery and activation for blockchain interactions. The package supports Chainlink services including CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including prompting guidelines and API integration. It supports BFL API features such as polling and webhooks, specifically offering eight specialist skills for the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agent skills by linking instructions to specific file lines or URLs. It features automated workflows for the entire lifecycle of a skill, from initial briefing to testing and export.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution via a Python client or CLI. It uniquely integrates commerce features by supporting skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates through a single Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local execution records and journals in a dedicated traces directory for macOS and Linux environments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from execution failures.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and provides a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a 5-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The architecture reduces token usage and supports graceful degradation if dependencies or embedding models are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution OS, this project uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and system design. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by using three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It utilizes deterministic pre-scans with tools like semgrep and bandit, then verifies findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It supports 97 languages and can reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite by scoring prompts across five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill simplifies code using three parallel sub-agents focused on Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust through a tiered application process that includes an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a systematic investigation protocol. It also features a Python goal engine to manage persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session management for memory between agent conversations and orchestrate parallel subagents for architectural and adversarial reviews. The toolkit also includes tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure secure local monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright scripts. It handles rendering, compression to under 8 MB, and automatic embedding into README markdown files.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills via the remoteopenclaw.com database. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable Agent Skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs for drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain current and functional.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic tool creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It allows Hermes Agent to verify and select compatible interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports OpenClaw and Hermes Agent environments.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It features a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns and extracts structured data from PDFs using macOS Vision.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin facilitates earning USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and managing boards, with payments triggered by human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and workspace Postgres integration. It supports agentskills.io compatible clients and offers an MCP server option for automated agent configuration.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis featuring core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis to execute financial trading strategies. It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages coding agents like Hermes and Claude using persistent tmux sessions for background execution and container-based isolation. It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs across specialist teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure quality and implementation standards.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a dedicated Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It leverages Ollama for parallel model querying and synthesis without relying on cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports cross-file resolution for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust, integrating with agents like Hermes via an MCP server.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a terminal user interface and a 3D visualization dashboard to monitor consumption and participate in public leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes, Codex, and Gemini. It ensures security by redacting authentication headers and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for analyzing exported trace sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 37+ other AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to maintain consistent usage data across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown, including Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and ship applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. Using YAML-based configurations, developers can apply diverse aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent commerce through Solana-based payments and identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It enables persistent memory across chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static analysis tool performs deterministic linting of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring runtime model execution. It identifies ambiguous descriptions and contract mismatches, integrating directly into CI workflows via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This utility automates the installation of a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible formats. It maps existing configurations into Hermes YAML and JSON while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic local runtime designed for executing commercial opportunities with Hermes Agent. It enforces a security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract types.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides tools for the management and retrieval of agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for configuring Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one administrative hub for multiple agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It distinguishes itself by supporting 24/7 automation via Cron and offering remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface enables mobile and desktop access to Hermes Agent without a build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes-studio is a comprehensive web dashboard that integrates Hermes Agent with communication channels like Telegram, Discord, and Slack. It offers advanced features such as visual workflow building with human approval gates, scheduled jobs, and detailed usage analytics for cost and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other coding agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It supports fifteen built-in agents and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed specifically as a native Mac workspace, this tool offers direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, alongside native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a specialized Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check and update capabilities. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat, memory management, and process control.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges active browser context with local or remote Hermes runtimes. It allows users to toggle specific tabs for agent context and supports multi-agent group chats with synced conversation histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to a hermes-webui server without third-party relays. It enables mobile management of agent chats, server files, skills, and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight provides a desktop workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that searches local history for 16 active agent formats and resumes supported CLI sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp. It functions as an analytics cockpit by tracking Codex and Claude quota burn and estimated API costs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and streaming SSE responses.
